notes.title: Patch V1.07 and Games 4 Change nomination!
notes.notes:
Hello there friend!

A few days ago two critical bugs came to my attention; one that let the player use the bed interaction when they were not supposed to (and that could have severe consequences if they did), and another that prevents the player from completing the game at the end of the second week. I just finished fixing them, and have uploaded the fixes for you! 

I found the bugs thanks to a small youtube channel named ZockZimmer and I wanted to do a shout out to the video in question, as it helped me identify the problems! :instantcoffee:

In addition, I took the liberty of adding a text file with the lyrics for Clear Skies which features the awesome voice of my brother Chris. If you have downloaded the game's OST, the lyrics will be in the Soundtrack folder together with the music. :headset:

In other news, Please Knock on My Door was recently nominated for Best Gameplay in the Games 4 Change Awards! I KNOW RIGHT? Pretty cool.

The award ceremony will be at the event itself, running June 28-30 in New York. Through this competition PKoMD is also featured in the Polygon x Games for Change People's Choice Award! If PKoMD offered you something special, please consider voting for it in the competition. 

That's all for this time! :eveningtree:

Take care,
Michael L

notes.title: Patch V1.06 and about those translations
notes.notes:
Hello!

You might be wondering, 'where did 1.05 go?' Well, I sneaked it on to Steam to test a few things about a week back, found a change I needed to make, and so here is 1.06! Yay!

It fixes an issue where a player could get stuck in the living room, unable to interact with anything. It was a rare issue, but it still feels good to have it fixed. ːinstantcoffeeː

Now, about those translations. I keep getting the occasional request, so I felt it would be good to adress it in an open post so I can direct people here in the future. If you're reading this because I directed you here; Welcome! I hope the future is treating you great.

Short answer: I still have no plans to implement translations. If that's all the info you need, feel free to move on with your internet activities.

Long answer: During the development leading up to the release of PKoMD, I worked crazy amounts of overtime. I won't go deep into it, but it left me exhausted to the point where it was very difficult to work on the game after it was released. I am now beginning to feel more adjusted, and my work/life balance is reaching somewhat normal levels again. I'm afraid that, promising another feature like this, would only lead me down another rabbit hole of exhaustion and everything that comes with. I won't say that it will never happen in the future. I will say, though, that I can't promise anything. I do appreciate all of your support, and I feel like asking for translations is a good indicator that there are people out there who like the game. Or at the very least, who would like to play it. ːeveningtreeː

Thank you for reading this far! I appreciate your support, and am thankful for all the love you've shown the game. I read every single user review that gets posted, so if you want to share your thoughts with me, that's a sure way of doing it!

Take care,
Michael L

notes.title: Release date and trailer!
notes.notes:
Please Knock on My Door will be released on September 7th and will be available on Windows PC.

Watch the release trailer on the Steam store page or on Youtube!

See you in September!
